limitations.java_capability: Forge/NeoForge runtime classes, mixins, event bus and networking
limitations.bedrock_limit: Bedrock cannot load Java bytecode, mixins or Forge event handlers.
limitations.replacement: Recreated supported gameplay with @minecraft/server scripts, Bedrock entity components, item/block components and UI forms. Java class-only behavior without a mapped gameplay handler remains explicitly listed in the gap audit.

limitations.java_capability: Arbitrary Java dimension serializers and noise settings
limitations.bedrock_limit: Bedrock custom dimensions use Bedrock dimension definitions and supported generators; Java serializer/noise code cannot be imported.
limitations.replacement: Independent custom dimension IDs with scripted chunk/structure construction and biome approximations; custom terrain profiles are built from Bedrock-safe blocks and scheduled batches.

limitations.java_capability: Java configured/placed features, biome modifiers and structure sets
limitations.bedrock_limit: Java worldgen registries and placement modifiers are not Bedrock feature-rule JSON.
limitations.replacement: Mapped to Bedrock features/feature rules where possible; unsupported placement logic is recreated with chunk-aware script placement and deterministic spacing.

limitations.java_capability: Java NBT block entities, jigsaw pools and processors
limitations.bedrock_limit: Java NBT schema and jigsaw runtime are not Bedrock .mcstructure or structure-pool formats.
limitations.replacement: Converted block palettes/states and supported block entities to Bedrock .mcstructure; split oversized structures and scripted placement; unsupported processors/connectors are omitted or replaced with fixed block placement.

limitations.java_capability: ManasCore skill storage, mastery points, network packets and skill event lifecycle
limitations.bedrock_limit: No ManasCore runtime or Java skill-instance implementation exists in Bedrock.
limitations.replacement: Persistent dynamic-property skill ownership, mastery, horn slot assignments, active/passive loadouts, scripted cooldowns and AP/MP/SP costs. Some passive/AI interactions are approximations.

limitations.java_capability: Java custom item NBT/data components and loot functions
limitations.bedrock_limit: Java item stacks, arbitrary NBT and custom loot functions do not map directly.
limitations.replacement: Unique Bedrock item identifiers, script-driven manuals/tomes, and Bedrock loot functions. Unsupported Java functions are catalogued with substitutes or omission notes.

limitations.java_capability: Java custom UI/container menus and rendering hooks
limitations.bedrock_limit: Forge screen classes and custom render pipelines cannot be loaded on Bedrock.
limitations.replacement: Mobile-friendly ActionFormData/ModalFormData menus, item horns/compasses and resource-pack UI/HUD assets.

limitations.java_capability: Java entity AI goals, attributes, race interfaces and custom capabilities
limitations.bedrock_limit: Java AI goal classes and capability interfaces have no direct Bedrock counterpart.
limitations.replacement: Bedrock behavior components, component groups, events, scripts, effects, health/scale attributes and custom entity state.

limitations.java_capability: Java recipe serializers and station-specific recipe logic
limitations.bedrock_limit: Custom Java serializers are not accepted by Bedrock crafting recipe JSON.
limitations.replacement: 220 native recipes plus five script-backed mobile workstations for 643 custom recipe records.

limitations.bedrock_limit: Java advancement and archaeology event schemas differ from Bedrock triggers.
limitations.replacement: Converted loot-table data is retained in Bedrock format; source-specific trigger behavior requires scripted event hooks and is not claimed as one-to-one parity.
